name: distributed-study-room
description: Distributed Collaborative Study Room — MERN Stack

scripts.postinstall: npm run install:client && npm run install:server
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run gateway" "npm run node:a" "npm run node:b" "npm run node:c" "npm run client"
scripts.node:a: cd server && cross-env NODE_ID=node-A NODE_PORT=5001 node nodes/nodeA/server.js
scripts.node:b: cd server && cross-env NODE_ID=node-B NODE_PORT=5002 node nodes/nodeB/server.js
scripts.node:c: cd server && cross-env NODE_ID=node-C NODE_PORT=5003 node nodes/nodeC/server.js
